## Executive Summary

This report delivers a cross-market comparative analysis spanning **2026-01-01** through **2026-10-15**.

The benchmark coverage is split into two primary investment asset groups:
1. **Global Equity Indices:** KOSPI (`^KS11`), TAIEX (`^TWII`), Nikkei 225 (`^N225`), Nasdaq (`^IXIC`), and Dow Jones (`^DJI`).
2. **MANGO-S AI Infrastructure Cluster:**
   * **M** – **Meta** (`META`)
   * **A** – **Anthropic** *(via Amazon `AMZN` strategic proxy)*
   * **N** – **Nvidia** (`NVDA`)
   * **G** – **Google / Alphabet** (`GOOGL`)
   * **O** – **OpenAI** *(via Microsoft `MSFT` strategic proxy)*
   * **S** – **SpaceX / xAI** *(via Tesla `TSLA` strategic proxy)*

---

## 1. Automated Data Ingestion & Transformation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Download all OHLCV market series in a single quantmod call
getSymbols(unname(ALL_TICKERS), src = "yahoo", from = START_DATE, to = END_DATE, auto.assign = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
 [1] "KS11"  "TWII"  "N225"  "IXIC"  "DJI"   "META"  "AMZN"  "NVDA"  "GOOGL"
[10] "MSFT"  "TSLA" 
```
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# Robust data parsing helper function
process_market_data <- function(display_name, symbol, category_group) {
  env_obj_name <- gsub("^\\^", "", symbol)
  
  if (!exists(env_obj_name)) {
    warning(paste("Symbol object not found in environment:", env_obj_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  xts_obj <- get(env_obj_name)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Date   = index(xts_obj),
    Close  = as.numeric(xts_obj[, 4]), # Closing price/level
    Volume = as.numeric(xts_obj[, 5])  # Trading volume
  ) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    filter(Date >= START_DATE & Date <= END_DATE) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      Index_Name       = display_name,
      Asset_Name       = display_name,  # Alias to ensure backwards compatibility
      Category         = category_group,
      Normalized_Close = (Close / first(Close)) * 100, # Base 100 normalization
      Daily_Return_Pct = (Close - lag(Close)) / lag(Close) * 100,
      Volume_M         = Volume / 1e6,
      Direction        = ifelse(Daily_Return_Pct >= 0, "Up", "Down")
    )
  
  return(df)
}

# Process both asset categories
df_indices_tmp <- bind_rows(lapply(names(INDEX_TICKERS), function(n) {
  process_market_data(n, INDEX_TICKERS[[n]], "Global Market Index")
}))

df_mangos_tmp <- bind_rows(lapply(names(MANGOS_TICKERS), function(n) {
  process_market_data(n, MANGOS_TICKERS[[n]], "MANGO-S AI Cluster")
}))

# Master Combined Dataframe
df_all_markets <- bind_rows(df_indices_tmp, df_mangos_tmp)

# Explicit Subsets for Categorical Plots
df_indices <- df_all_markets %>% filter(Category == "Global Market Index")
df_mangos  <- df_all_markets %>% filter(Category == "MANGO-S AI Cluster")
```
:::

## 2. Relative Base-100 Performance Trajectories

Indexing each market to **100 on 2026-01-01** allows direct multi-asset comparison without point-scale distortion.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(df_indices, aes(x = Date, y = Normalized_Close, color = Index_Name)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, color = "gray40", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = PEAK_DATE, color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative Trajectories: Global Benchmark Indices",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Indexed Level (Base = 100)",
    color = "Global Index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
```

## 4. Single-Page Focus Dashboard: KOSPI vs. Nvidia (`NVDA`)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Safely filter directly from df_all_markets
df_kospi <- df_all_markets %>% filter(Index_Name == "KOSPI")
df_nvda  <- df_all_markets %>% filter(Index_Name == "Nvidia")

p_kospi <- ggplot(df_kospi, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "KOSPI Index Close Level", y = "Index Level", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), axis.text.x = element_blank())

p_nvda <- ggplot(df_nvda, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line(color = "#76b900", linewidth = 1) + # Nvidia green
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Nvidia (NVDA) Share Price ($USD)", y = "Price ($)", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), axis.text.x = element_blank())

p_returns <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = df_kospi, aes(x = Date, y = Daily_Return_Pct, color = "KOSPI"), linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_nvda, aes(x = Date, y = Daily_Return_Pct, color = "Nvidia"), linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("KOSPI" = "#1f77b4", "Nvidia" = "#76b900")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(title = "Daily Return Overlay (%)", y = "Daily Change (%)", x = "Date", color = "Asset") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), legend.position = "bottom")

# Combine panels vertically using patchwork
p_kospi / p_nvda / p_returns
```

## 5. Integrated Statistical Summary


::: {#tbl-summary-stats .cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
summary_table <- df_all_markets %>%
  group_by(Category, Index_Name) %>%
  summarize(
    Start_Close      = first(Close),
    Current_Close    = last(Close),
    Period_High      = max(Close, na.rm = TRUE),
    Period_Low       = min(Close, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Return     = paste0(round(((last(Close) - first(Close)) / first(Close)) * 100, 2), "%"),
    Daily_Volatility = round(sd(Daily_Return_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

kable(
  summary_table, 
  col.names = c("Category Group", "Asset / Ticker", "Start Price", "Current Price", "Period High", "Period Low", "Total Return (%)", "Daily Volatility (Std Dev)")
)
```
